Dear Hiring Manager/Team at Adolescent Wellness Academy,

I am writing to express my strong interest in the Adolescent Services Manager position at Adolescent Wellness Academy. With a Master’s degree in Human Services and over 28 years of experience leading child welfare teams, I am excited about the opportunity to bring my background in quality assurance and program excellence to your organization.

Throughout my career, I have focused on translating complex state regulations into high-quality, day-to-day care.  As a manager, I have led and mentored teams of 20 to 35 case managers and supervisors. By balancing caseloads, providing targeted staff coaching, and streamlining paperwork, I have successfully maintained high standards of care while keeping staff burnout low.

I also bring a strong background in risk management and compliance.  I have personally led internal audit preparations and file reviews for formal Florida DCF reviews to ensure our daily operations met every state requirement.  I know exactly what it takes to keep a program audit-ready, safeguard funding, and protect the safety and integrity of client files.

Adolescent Wellness Academy’s “dedication and commitment to guiding troubled teens and their families towards growth, resilience, and lasting mental health”, perfectly matches my own approach to human services.  I am confident that my master's-level training, paired with my decades of supervisory and regulatory experience, makes me an excellent fit to lead your team.

Thank you for your time, consideration, and review of my application. I welcome the opportunity to discuss how my leadership capabilities can support the ongoing success of your programs.

Sincerely,

Fiona Evans

candidates.cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Manager,
As a compassionate and detail-oriented mental health professional with over 20 years of experience in behavioral health, I was excited to see the admissions coordinator position at Adolescent Wellness Academy. With a proven track record in admissions coordination, client assessments, case management, and supporting individuals and families through recovery, I am eager to bring my empathy, clinical insight, and organizational strengths to your team.
From 2014 to 2024, I held progressive roles in residential treatment and case management, including serving as Admissions Specialist at Monte Nido, where I managed the full admission process — from initial inquiries and biopsychosocial assessments to insurance coordination and client transitions. I later provided direct care as a Case Manager and Group Facilitator at Recovery is a Beach and Rise Malibu, conducting assessments (including PHQ-9 and GAD-7), developing individualized care plans, facilitating groups, and ensuring seamless coordination with multidisciplinary teams. After welcoming my son in late 2024, I chose to take dedicated time off of work to care for my family. I am now fully refreshed and excited to return to the field with even greater enthusiasm and commitment.
My personal recovery of 22 years continues to fuel my dedication to meeting clients and families with genuine understanding and hope. Whether building rapport with clients and their loved ones, highlighting and explaining the benefits of a particular treatment program, actively listening, collaborating with clinical teams, or maintaining thorough documentation, I bring both professional expertise and heartfelt empathy to every interaction. I am confident my combination of direct admissions experience, case management, group facilitation, strong communication skills, and recovery-informed perspective would enable me to contribute meaningfully from day one.
Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of speaking with you soon.

**September 4, 2026**

**Hiring Committee**
**Re: Clinic Director – Adolescent Mental Health**

Dear Hiring Committee:

I am writing to express my interest in the Clinic Director – Adolescent Mental Health position. As a Licensed Clinical Mental Health Counselor and National Certified Counselor with more than 25 years of behavioral health experience, I bring a strong combination of clinical leadership, adolescent mental health expertise, program oversight, and organizational management.

Throughout my career, I have worked extensively with adolescents and families experiencing complex behavioral, emotional, trauma-related, and family-system concerns. My background includes outpatient and community-based treatment, intensive in-home services, clinical supervision, treatment planning, crisis intervention, and coordination of care. These experiences have given me a strong understanding of both the clinical needs of adolescents and the importance of engaging families and multidisciplinary providers in effective treatment.

For more than a decade, I have also owned and operated Cates Counseling and Consulting, PLLC, where I am responsible for clinical operations, quality of care, ethical and regulatory compliance, program development, and organizational decision-making. This experience has strengthened my ability to balance excellent clinical care with the operational responsibilities required to lead a successful behavioral health program.

In addition to my clinical background, I hold a PhD in Forensic Psychology with a specialization in Victimology. My doctoral training further developed my expertise in trauma, adolescent behavior, family systems, victimization, and the factors that can contribute to behavioral and emotional difficulties among young people.

I am excited about the opportunity to return to a leadership role focused on adolescents while supporting clinicians in delivering high-quality, trauma-informed, evidence-based care. I would welcome the opportunity to bring my clinical experience, leadership skills, and commitment to young people and families to your organization.

Thank you for your consideration. I look forward to discussing how my experience can contribute to your team and the adolescents and families you serve.

Sincerely,

**Dr. Nzinga Cates, PhD, LCMHC, NCC**
Founder & Owner
Cates Counseling and Consulting, PLLC

Sincerely,
Nicole Ballen

candidates.summary: Good facilitation should encourage authentic self-expression. I believe in creating engaging and creative environments where adolescents feel safe to explore their emotions. As a Creative Group Facilitator, I thrive on leading sessions that integrate various artistic mediums to help young people articulate their thoughts and feelings. My goal is to foster connections, promote emotional wellness, and encourage creative expression among participants. Experienced in facilitating virtual groups for adolescents aged 13-17, ensuring engagement and connection. Proficient in creating structured, age-appropriate activities that incorporate diverse creative expressions like art, music, and movement. Dedicated to trauma-informed approaches that resonate with young individuals, promoting a strengths-based environment.

work_history.title: Creative Group Facilitator
work_history.summary: Facilitate 2-3 live virtual creative groups each week, using artistic approaches such as art, music, and movement to engage adolescents aged 13-17 in therapeutic sessions. Design and implement structured, age-appropriate activities that promote emotional expression and creativity, fostering a supportive environment for participants. Utilize trauma-informed care methods to address the unique emotional needs of adolescents, ensuring a safe space for self-exploration and connection. Maintain consistent attendance records and documentation, streamlining administrative tasks to focus on delivering impactful group sessions. Employ engaging virtual tools to enhance creativity and facilitate interaction among group members, making sessions more dynamic and participatory. Tailor sessions to reflect the individual dynamics of each group, adapting activities in real-time to meet varying emotional needs and engagement levels. Collaborate with mental health professionals to ensure the activities align with therapeutic goals and the holistic well-being of participants. Foster connections among group members to create a sense of community, significantly increasing overall group satisfaction and emotional support. Encourage participants to share their creative expressions, facilitating discussions that promote peer support and understanding. Actively seek feedback from participants to continuously improve session effectiveness and relevance to their personal experiences. Integrate mindfulness practices into sessions, helping participants develop coping strategies and selfawareness. Create resources and handouts that further encourage creative exploration outside of group sessions. Develop and implement a participant exit survey to gather insights on session effectiveness, utilizing the feedback to refine future programming.

work_history.title: Group Facilitator
work_history.summary: Led a variety of group workshops focused on creative expression for adolescents, incorporating art, music, and writing to facilitate emotional sharing. Created a safe and engaging environment for adolescents, ensuring that each session was tailored to their developmental stages and interests. Executed structured group sessions that encouraged teamwork and collaboration, significantly enhancing the participants' social skills and emotional literacy. Maintained documentation of group attendance and engagement metrics, analyzing trends to optimize session formats and topics. Implemented feedback mechanisms within group activities to ensure participants' voices were heard, adapting discussions to enhance emotional impact. Collaborated with other facilitators to develop comprehensive programming that included parental involvement, bridging support between home and group settings. Conduced workshops on mindfulness strategies tailored for youth, helping participants cultivate coping mechanisms for managing stress and anxiety. Utilized digital tools for remote group engagement, effectively transitioning traditional in-person programs into virtual formats during the pandemic. Designed and executed interactive activities utilizing art and music to inspire emotional expression and creativity during virtual sessions, ensuring each participant felt valued and included as they navigated their feelings through innovative mediums like digital storytelling and virtual paint sessions. Utilized trauma-informed practices to create a supportive atmosphere that addressed the unique needs of adolescents, carefully selecting activities that resonated with their life experiences, thereby fostering trust and encouraging meaningful connections among participants. Leveraged advanced video conferencing tools to maintain high levels of engagement** and interaction, ensuring that each virtual session replicated the warmth and connectivity of in-person gatherings while introducing new platforms to enhance creativity and participation. Continuously developed and refined a structured curriculum that combined mindfulness strategies with creative expression, allowing participants to explore their thoughts and emotions through various outlets, which significantly contributed to their overall mental wellness. Conducted one-on-one check-ins with participants after group activities to assess understanding and emotional impact, tailoring future sessions based on individual feedback to maximize personal growth and connection within the group dynamics. Fostered a culture of peer support and collaboration by integrating small group discussions and creative projects into larger sessions, which not only enhanced social skills but also built lasting friendships among participants that transcended the virtual space. Implemented engaging, age-appropriate virtual challenges and competitions that encouraged participants to express themselves creatively while allowing for self-reflection, thus promoting personal accountability and resilience in facing life's adversities. Monitored and evaluated virtual group dynamics through detailed documentation of attendance and session feedback, using insights gained to continuously enhance program effectiveness and address any barriers to engagement experienced by participants.

work_history.title: Creative Activities Coordinator
work_history.summary: Designed and implemented engaging creative arts programs for adolescents, emphasizing hands-on experiences and emotional exploration through creativity. Facilitated daily group sessions focused on artistic expression, helping campers articulate their emotions while enhancing their social connections. Collaborated with a diverse team of educators to create interdisciplinary programs that integrated creative arts with educational outcomes. Managed logistics of group activities, ensuring all materials were prepared and available for a smooth and productive experience for campers. Evaluated participant feedback to refine programming, making adjustments that increased participation and satisfaction throughout the camp. Developed and led weekly live virtual group sessions focused on creative writing and storytelling, utilizing platforms like Zoom to foster an engaging environment where adolescents could share their narratives, aiding in their emotional expression and personal growth, thus ensuring participants felt connected despite geographical distances. Implemented structured, age-appropriate art activities that encouraged self-exploration and collaboration among adolescents, using diverse techniques such as mixed media and digital tools, which promoted creativity while navigating the challenges of varied skill levels and interests within the group. Utilized data from attendance and participant engagement metrics to assess the effectiveness of virtual creative activities, refining program strategies to enhance the impact of group sessions on participants' emotional well-being and sense of community throughout the camp experience. Established guidelines for a trauma-informed care approach within creative group settings, ensuring that all activities promoted psychological safety and inclusivity, thereby offering a supportive space where adolescents felt empowered to express themselves without fear of judgment. Created and implemented interactive methods for maintaining participant engagement during virtual sessions, incorporating elements like polls and breakout rooms to foster deeper connections and discussions among adolescents, which significantly enriched their group experience and emotional involvement. Orchestrated collaborative projects involving multiple creative disciplines such as music and visual arts, allowing campers to explore various forms of expression, while carefully managing time and resources to deliver thoughtful, high-quality programming that emphasized both emotional and creative development.
